digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI — CodeQL workflow scheduling
propositions: CodeQL workflow originally ran on every push to main plus a weekly cron; after push trigger removal (commit 03ef), weekly became the primary scan of newly-landed code rather than a backstop, allowing up to 7 days of exposure for new SAST findings
CodeQL cadence was changed from weekly (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to restore intended coverage parity and reduce worst-case exposure to 6 hours
The 6-hourly cadence is cost-justified for public repository with free CodeQL and Actions minutes, invalidating the prior '28x increase' rationale

CodeQL workflow retains no push trigger and workflow_dispatch, but joins a new schedule-only 6-hourly cohort separate from push-triggered lanes, with distinct off-the-hour minute (35) staggered against test.yml (41), optionality.yml (47), and verify-identity.yml (53)
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py was retargeted to pin the new cadence and staggering invariant without deleting existing assertions about no-push and workflow_dispatch triggers
